parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is at 4 VP and needs only one more point to win. She is trying to convince Ziv to trade her a sheep (כבשה) by offering wood (עץ) for his port. Even though Ziv already refused, she's being persistent. I need to keep reminding Ziv that she is at match point and that my wheat (חיטה) is currently blocked by the robber she placed. If she gets that sheep, she could win with a development card or a settlement if she finds brick (טיט) later.
